title: Painting a Bighorn Ram
content: This morning I painted this demo in black and white casein at theSKB Workshopin Dubois, Wyoming. I used a reddish brown water-soluble colored pencil for the lay-in, and that color peeks through here and there.The taxidermy is by Lynn Stewart. It's nice to have an animal that holds still!TheSKB Workshophas about 150 students and 15 instructors this year, with meals together and lots of time to hang out and talk, talk painting gear, paint out on ranches and eat meals together.
